premium_calls_description: Host video calls with hundreds of people, get moderator controls, secure your meetings with Leo AI assistant tailored to your private sessions without compromising confidentiality. No installation needed.
recovery_token_description: If you're the moderator of a recurring meeting, you may export your call's unique token each time you set up a new call, and keep this token in a safe place. You'll need this token to retain moderator privileges in cases where you need to reinstall the browser or install on a new device.
recovery_token_description_free: If you're the moderator of a recurring meeting and have a recovery token, you may recover rooms here.
recordings_description: Recorded calls are automatically deleted 24 hours after their recording time.
recovery_token_dialog_textarea_placehold: Generate a new recovery token by clicking the "Generate new token" below. If you want to recover your token, paste it here and click "Load token".

recovery_token_dialog_learn_more: Learn more about how this works.
recovery_token_dialog_description: This token will allow you to restore moderator privileges in any recurring meeting you've created. You should treat this token like a unique password and keep it in a safe place. Each time you set up a new, recurring meeting, click Generate new token. If you need to reset your browser or install Brave on a new device, you can paste your token in the text box above and click Load token. This will recover the token on the device, and restore your moderator privileges.
